# BaarliClaw Agent System v2.0

A fully self-improving AI agent system with mandatory pre-flight checks,
automatic learning capture, and comprehensive automation.

## Features

- ✅ 100% Automatic Self-Improvement
- ✅ Mandatory Pre-Flight with Quiz Validation
- ✅ Automatic Learning Capture
- ✅ 5 Automated Cron Jobs
- ✅ 5 Custom Skills
- ✅ 33 Automation Scripts
- ✅ Web Dashboard
- ✅ JSON API

## Quick Start

1. Run pre-flight: `bash scripts/auto-exec-enforcer.sh`
2. Check status: `bash scripts/agent-dashboard.sh`
3. View dashboard: Open `dashboard/index.html`

- MEMORY.md - Main knowledge base
